verdict.rationale: Skyvern's debugging docs say every run automatically captures browser session recordings, per-step screenshots, the AI's reasoning, and network traffic, which covers the video and screenshot parts of the story. A community user independently praises the observability of workflow steps, and a Copilot chat is offered for debugging workflows. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a step-by-step action timeline view, in-depth docs beyond a single summary line, and hands-on evidence of using replays to diagnose a failed run.
